sourceIdentity.observationMethod: GitHub main and commit status, GitHub Production deployment status, immutable deployment HTTP, canonical alias HTTP, exact live-byte comparison, and production browser QA

deploymentAttempts.qualification: Vercel commit-status timing and GitHub deployment timing are provider-native. Exact Vercel build duration, private deployment ID, and runtime logs are unavailable because the canonical repository has no Vercel CLI.

runtimeQa.qualification: Exact-deployment runtime logs and the private Vercel deployment ID were not queryable because the canonical repository has no Vercel CLI. Runtime confidence is limited to exact GitHub Production success, direct HTTP 200, twelve live-to-local byte identities, and zero production browser console warnings or errors.

qaToolingInterventions: The protected-main push was initially denied by the external-write guard; no mutation occurred until the user explicitly authorized pushing content SHA fcb7f902cd9246f3db782ff5b20a2e5f69e00217 to production.
The first browser count matcher assumed newline-adjacent metric labels and returned false negatives; semantic dt/dd extraction then matched all twelve exact state counts.
Two deferred deployment polling cells returned no captured output; fresh provider queries established the pending and final success states without triggering another deployment.
latestVerifiedPriorRelease.clockQualification: Provider-native GitHub UTC timestamps control deployment timing. The local content commit timestamp and provider deployment window disagree by many hours, so externalVerificationSecondsFromContentCommit remains null; the exact Vercel status duration is 229 seconds and status-creation-to-final-verification is 432 seconds.
latestVerifiedPriorRelease.evidenceScope: Externally verified prior production release. This receipt is committed only after canonical, origin, public GitHub main, and GitHub API matched exact Round 61 content SHA fcb7f902cd9246f3db782ff5b20a2e5f69e00217; GitHub Production deployment 5925338862 succeeded; its immutable host and canonical production alias served all twelve intended routes; six selected Florida, Kentucky, California, and Maine files matched local SHA-256 and bytes on both hosts; and fresh desktop and mobile browser checks passed without broken images, console warnings, console errors, or horizontal overflow. Exact-deployment runtime logs and private Vercel deployment ID were unavailable. Round 61 completed 53,448 gross outcomes but moved 52,711 unique final-matrix pairs, including 3,270 verified-present and 49,441 researched-unresolved movements, completed 867 APHIS protocol cells, and added 85 derived applicability decisions. It created no verified-absence, not-detected, denominator, or conflict movement. This receipt does not attest to the commit that contains it or any future deployment.

releaseVerification.note: Build-time readiness and deployed-release evidence are separate. A committed artifact cannot attest to a future deployment of its own commit.

certification.promotionPolicy: Promote the next cohort when the active cohort is certified. Blocked states retain their blockers while independent states and the next cohort continue.
